```{python}
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import HTML, display
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Adjust these to match your HR zones and goals.

ZONE2_LOW = 120            # Zone 2 HR lower bound (bpm)
ZONE2_HIGH = 150           # Zone 2 HR upper bound (bpm)
MIN_MONTHLY_MILES = 25     # Minimum effective training month
TARGET_MONTHLY_MILES = 50  # Target monthly mileage
ROLLING_SHORT = 30         # Short rolling window (days)
ROLLING_LONG = 90          # Long rolling window (days)
REFERENCE_PACE = 14.0          # Reference pace for HR tracking (min/mi) — update as fitness improves
REFERENCE_PACE_BAND = 0.5      # ± band around reference pace (min)
RUNNA_START = pd.Timestamp("2026-03-01")  # Runna training plan start

# 10K readiness scorecard thresholds
MILEAGE_GREEN = 30         # 30-day mileage green threshold
MILEAGE_YELLOW = 20        # 30-day mileage yellow threshold
PACE_GREEN = 13.0          # Zone 2 pace green (min/mi, lower = better)
PACE_YELLOW = 14.5         # Zone 2 pace yellow
STREAK_GREEN = 3           # Month streak green threshold
STREAK_YELLOW = 1          # Month streak yellow threshold

DATA_DIR = Path("data")
STREAMS_DIR = DATA_DIR / "activity-streams"

# Chart styling
CHART_BG = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
GRID_COLOR = "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
CHART_HEIGHT = 450
CHART_MARGIN = dict(t=30, b=50, l=60, r=30)

def chart_layout(**kwargs):
    """Base layout kwargs shared by all charts."""
    base = dict(
        template="plotly_dark",
        height=CHART_HEIGHT,
        paper_bgcolor=CHART_BG,
        plot_bgcolor=CHART_BG,
        margin=CHART_MARGIN,
        legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02, xanchor="right", x=1),
    )
    base.update(kwargs)
    return base

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_pace(pace_str):
    """Convert 'M:SS' pace string to decimal minutes."""
    if not pace_str or (isinstance(pace_str, float) and np.isnan(pace_str)):
        return np.nan
    parts = str(pace_str).split(":")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return np.nan
    try:
        return int(parts[0]) + int(parts[1]) / 60
    except ValueError:
        return np.nan

def format_pace(minutes):
    """Convert decimal minutes to 'M:SS' string."""
    if pd.isna(minutes):
        return "--"
    m = int(minutes)
    s = int(round((minutes - m) * 60))
    if s == 60:
        m += 1
        s = 0
    return f"{m}:{s:02d}"

def traffic_light_color(value, green_thresh, yellow_thresh, lower_is_better=False):
    """Return hex color for scorecard."""
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "#6c757d"
    if lower_is_better:
        if value <= green_thresh:
            return "#198754"
        elif value <= yellow_thresh:
            return "#ffc107"
        return "#dc3545"
    else:
        if value >= green_thresh:
            return "#198754"
        elif value >= yellow_thresh:
            return "#ffc107"
        return "#dc3545"

# ── Load Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

runs = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "strava-runs-summary.csv")
runs["date"] = pd.to_datetime(runs["date"])
runs["pace_numeric"] = runs["avg_pace_per_mile"].apply(parse_pace)
runs["month"] = runs["date"].dt.to_period("M")
runs = runs[runs["date"] >= RUNNA_START].reset_index(drop=True)

soccer = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "strava-soccer-summary.csv")
soccer["date"] = pd.to_datetime(soccer["date"])
soccer["month"] = soccer["date"].dt.to_period("M")
soccer = soccer[soccer["date"] >= RUNNA_START].reset_index(drop=True)

# ── Zone 2 Pace Calculation ─────────────────────────────────────

z2_records = []
stream_files = sorted(STREAMS_DIR.glob("*.csv")) if STREAMS_DIR.exists() else []
stream_files = [f for f in stream_files if pd.Timestamp(f.stem[:10]) >= RUNNA_START]
stream_activity_ids = set()

for f in stream_files:
    parts = f.stem.split("-")
    activity_id = int(parts[-1])
    run_date = pd.Timestamp(f"{parts[0]}-{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}")
    stream_activity_ids.add(activity_id)

    sdf = pd.read_csv(f)
    sdf["heartrate"] = pd.to_numeric(sdf["heartrate"], errors="coerce")
    sdf["pace_numeric"] = sdf["pace_per_mile"].apply(parse_pace)

    z2 = sdf[
        (sdf["heartrate"] >= ZONE2_LOW)
        & (sdf["heartrate"] <= ZONE2_HIGH)
        & sdf["pace_numeric"].notna()
        & (sdf["pace_numeric"] > 0)
        & (sdf["pace_numeric"] < 20)
    ]

    if len(z2) >= 30:
        z2_records.append({
            "date": run_date,
            "z2_pace": z2["pace_numeric"].mean(),
            "z2_seconds": len(z2),
            "source": "stream",
        })

for _, row in runs.iterrows():
    aid = row.get("activity_id")
    if pd.notna(aid) and int(aid) in stream_activity_ids:
        continue
    if (
        pd.notna(row["avg_heartrate"])
        and ZONE2_LOW <= row["avg_heartrate"] <= ZONE2_HIGH
        and pd.notna(row["pace_numeric"])
        and 5 < row["pace_numeric"] < 20
    ):
        z2_records.append({
            "date": row["date"],
            "z2_pace": row["pace_numeric"],
            "z2_seconds": row.get("duration_seconds", 0),
            "source": "estimate",
        })

z2_df = pd.DataFrame(z2_records) if z2_records else pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["date", "z2_pace", "z2_seconds", "source"]
)
z2_monthly = pd.Series(dtype=float)
if not z2_df.empty:
    z2_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(z2_df["date"])
    z2_df["month"] = z2_df["date"].dt.to_period("M")
    z2_monthly = z2_df.groupby("month")["z2_pace"].mean()

# ── Monthly Volume ───────────────────────────────────────────────

all_months = pd.period_range(
    start=runs["date"].min(), end=runs["date"].max(), freq="M"
)
run_monthly = (
    runs.groupby("month")["distance_miles"].sum().reindex(all_months, fill_value=0)
)
soccer_monthly = soccer.groupby("month").size().reindex(all_months, fill_value=0)
month_labels = [m.start_time.strftime("%b '%y") for m in all_months]

# ── Training Intensity ───────────────────────────────────────────

zone_cols = sorted([c for c in runs.columns if c.startswith("hr_zone_") and c.endswith("_sec")])
zone_runs = runs[runs[zone_cols].sum(axis=1) > 0]
zone_monthly_secs = zone_runs.groupby("month")[zone_cols].sum().reindex(all_months, fill_value=0)
zone_totals = zone_monthly_secs.sum(axis=1)
zone_pct = zone_monthly_secs.div(zone_totals.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0) * 100
zone_pct = zone_pct.fillna(0)

# ── Aerobic Efficiency ───────────────────────────────────────────

ef_mask = (
    runs["avg_heartrate"].notna()
    & (runs["avg_heartrate"] > 0)
    & (runs["duration_seconds"] > 0)
    & (runs["distance_miles"] >= 1.0)
)
ef_runs = runs[ef_mask].copy()
ef_runs["speed_mph"] = ef_runs["distance_miles"] / (ef_runs["duration_seconds"] / 3600)
ef_runs["ef"] = ef_runs["speed_mph"] / ef_runs["avg_heartrate"] * 100
ef_runs = ef_runs[(ef_runs["ef"] > 1) & (ef_runs["ef"] < 10)]
ef_monthly = ef_runs.groupby("month")["ef"].mean()

# ── Month Streak ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

streak = 0
for m in reversed(all_months):
    if run_monthly.get(m, 0) >= MIN_MONTHLY_MILES:
        streak += 1
    else:
        break

# ── Rolling Mileage ──────────────────────────────────────────────

daily_runs_dict = runs.groupby(runs["date"].dt.date)["distance_miles"].sum().to_dict()
date_range = pd.date_range(
    start=runs["date"].min().normalize(),
    end=runs["date"].max().normalize(),
    freq="D",
)
daily = pd.DataFrame({"date": date_range})
daily["miles"] = daily["date"].map(lambda d: daily_runs_dict.get(d.date(), 0))
daily["rolling_30d"] = daily["miles"].rolling(ROLLING_SHORT, min_periods=1).sum()
daily["rolling_90d"] = daily["miles"].rolling(ROLLING_LONG, min_periods=1).sum()

# ── Cardiac Drift ────────────────────────────────────────────────

drift_records = []
for f in stream_files:
    parts = f.stem.split("-")
    run_date = pd.Timestamp(f"{parts[0]}-{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}")

    sdf = pd.read_csv(f)
    sdf["heartrate"] = pd.to_numeric(sdf["heartrate"], errors="coerce")
    sdf["pace_numeric"] = sdf["pace_per_mile"].apply(parse_pace)

    running = sdf[
        sdf["heartrate"].notna()
        & sdf["pace_numeric"].notna()
        & (sdf["pace_numeric"] > 0)
        & (sdf["pace_numeric"] < 20)
    ]

    if len(running) < 120:
        continue

    mid = len(running) // 2
    hr_first = running.iloc[:mid]["heartrate"].mean()
    hr_second = running.iloc[mid:]["heartrate"].mean()

    if hr_first > 0:
        drift_records.append({
            "date": run_date,
            "drift_pct": round((hr_second - hr_first) / hr_first * 100, 1),
        })

drift_df = pd.DataFrame(drift_records) if drift_records else pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["date", "drift_pct"]
)
if not drift_df.empty:
    drift_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(drift_df["date"])

# ── Pace-HR Relationship ────────────────────────────────────────

ref_pace_records = []
scatter_chunks = []

for f in stream_files:
    parts = f.stem.split("-")
    run_date = pd.Timestamp(f"{parts[0]}-{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}")

    sdf = pd.read_csv(f)
    sdf["heartrate"] = pd.to_numeric(sdf["heartrate"], errors="coerce")
    sdf["pace_numeric"] = sdf["pace_per_mile"].apply(parse_pace)

    valid = sdf[
        sdf["heartrate"].notna()
        & (sdf["heartrate"] > 0)
        & sdf["pace_numeric"].notna()
        & (sdf["pace_numeric"] > 5)
        & (sdf["pace_numeric"] < 25)
    ].copy()

    if len(valid) < 60:
        continue

    in_band = valid[
        (valid["pace_numeric"] >= REFERENCE_PACE - REFERENCE_PACE_BAND)
        & (valid["pace_numeric"] <= REFERENCE_PACE + REFERENCE_PACE_BAND)
    ]
    if len(in_band) >= 30:
        ref_pace_records.append({
            "date": run_date,
            "median_hr": in_band["heartrate"].median(),
            "n_seconds": len(in_band),
        })

    valid["chunk"] = np.arange(len(valid)) // 30
    downsampled = valid.groupby("chunk").agg(
        pace=("pace_numeric", "mean"),
        hr=("heartrate", "mean"),
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    downsampled["date"] = run_date
    scatter_chunks.append(downsampled)

ref_pace_df = pd.DataFrame(ref_pace_records) if ref_pace_records else pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["date", "median_hr", "n_seconds"]
)
if not ref_pace_df.empty:
    ref_pace_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(ref_pace_df["date"])

scatter_df = pd.concat(scatter_chunks, ignore_index=True) if scatter_chunks else pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["pace", "hr", "date"]
)
if not scatter_df.empty:
    scatter_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(scatter_df["date"])

pace_adj_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["date", "adjusted_hr", "model_hr"])
pace_adj_bpm_month = np.nan
if not scatter_df.empty and len(scatter_df) >= 30:
    _d0 = scatter_df["date"].min()
    scatter_df["date_days"] = (scatter_df["date"] - _d0).dt.days
    _X = np.column_stack([
        np.ones(len(scatter_df)),
        scatter_df["pace"].values,
        scatter_df["date_days"].values,
    ])
    _beta = np.linalg.lstsq(_X, scatter_df["hr"].values, rcond=None)[0]
    scatter_df["_resid"] = scatter_df["hr"] - (
        _beta[0] + _beta[1] * scatter_df["pace"] + _beta[2] * scatter_df["date_days"]
    )
    _rd = scatter_df.groupby("date").agg(
        date_days=("date_days", "first"),
        mean_resid=("_resid", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    _rd["model_hr"] = _beta[0] + _beta[1] * REFERENCE_PACE + _beta[2] * _rd["date_days"]
    _rd["adjusted_hr"] = _rd["model_hr"] + _rd["mean_resid"]
    pace_adj_df = _rd[["date", "adjusted_hr", "model_hr"]].copy()
    pace_adj_bpm_month = _beta[2] * 30
    scatter_df.drop(columns=["_resid"], inplace=True)

# ── Scorecard Metrics ────────────────────────────────────────────

current_30d = daily["rolling_30d"].iloc[-1] if len(daily) > 0 else 0

if not z2_df.empty:
    recent_z2 = z2_df.sort_values("date", ascending=False).head(3)["z2_pace"].mean()
else:
    recent_z2 = np.nan

# ── Mile Splits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

split_records = []
for f in stream_files:
    parts = f.stem.split("-")
    run_date = pd.Timestamp(f"{parts[0]}-{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}")

    sdf = pd.read_csv(f)
    sdf["distance_miles"] = pd.to_numeric(sdf["distance_miles"], errors="coerce")

    max_dist = sdf["distance_miles"].max()
    if pd.isna(max_dist) or max_dist < 1:
        continue

    for mile in range(1, int(max_dist) + 1):
        start_rows = sdf[sdf["distance_miles"] >= mile - 1]
        end_rows = sdf[sdf["distance_miles"] >= mile]
        if start_rows.empty or end_rows.empty:
            continue

        t_start = start_rows.iloc[0]["elapsed_seconds"]
        t_end = end_rows.iloc[0]["elapsed_seconds"]
        split_seconds = t_end - t_start

        if split_seconds > 0:
            split_records.append({
                "date": run_date,
                "mile": mile,
                "split_pace": split_seconds / 60,
            })

splits_df = pd.DataFrame(split_records) if split_records else pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["date", "mile", "split_pace"]
)
```

```{python}
# ── 10K Readiness Scorecard ──────────────────────────────────────

c1 = traffic_light_color(current_30d, MILEAGE_GREEN, MILEAGE_YELLOW)
c2 = traffic_light_color(recent_z2, PACE_GREEN, PACE_YELLOW, lower_is_better=True)
c3 = traffic_light_color(streak, STREAK_GREEN, STREAK_YELLOW)

card = (

    f'<div style="{card} background:{c1};">'

    f'<div style="{value}">{current_30d:.1f} mi</div></div>'
    f'<div style="{card} background:{c2};">'
    f'<div style="{label}">Zone 2 Pace (last 3 runs)</div>'
    f'<div style="{value}">{format_pace(recent_z2)} /mi</div></div>'
    f'<div style="{card} background:{c3};">'
    f'<div style="{label}">Month Streak (≥{MIN_MONTHLY_MILES} mi)</div>'
    f'<div style="{value}">{streak} mo</div></div>'
    f'</div>'
))
```

## Training Progress

```{python}
#| echo: false

fig = go.Figure()

if not runs.empty:
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=runs["date"], y=runs["pace_numeric"],
        mode="markers", showlegend=False,
        marker=dict(
            size=runs["distance_miles"] * 4,
            color=runs["distance_miles"],
            colorscale="Viridis",
            colorbar=dict(title="Miles", len=0.6, thickness=12),
            opacity=0.8,
            line=dict(width=0.5, color="white"),
        ),
        text=[f"{d:.1f} mi, {format_pace(p)}/mi" for d, p in
              zip(runs["distance_miles"], runs["pace_numeric"])],
        hovertemplate="%{x|%b %d}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>",
    ))

    valid = runs.dropna(subset=["pace_numeric"])
    if len(valid) >= 3:
        x_num = valid["date"].astype("int64") / 1e18
        z = np.polyfit(x_num, valid["pace_numeric"], 1)
        order = x_num.argsort()
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=valid["date"].iloc[order], y=np.poly1d(z)(x_num.iloc[order]),
            mode="lines", name="Pace trend",
            line=dict(color="#4dabf7", width=2, dash="dash"),
        ))

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    height=500,
    yaxis=dict(
        title="Pace (min/mi)", autorange="reversed",
        gridcolor=GRID_COLOR,
    ),
    xaxis=dict(gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    hovermode="closest",
    annotations=[dict(
        text="Faster is up. Bubble size = distance. Training started March 2026 with Runna.",
        xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0, y=-0.08,
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
    )],
))
fig.show()
```

## Mile Splits

```{python}
#| echo: false

fig = go.Figure()

if not splits_df.empty:
    pivot = splits_df.pivot_table(index="date", columns="mile", values="split_pace")
    pivot = pivot.sort_index()

    date_labels = [d.strftime("%b %d") for d in pivot.index]
    mile_labels = [f"Mile {int(m)}" for m in pivot.columns]

    hover_text = []
    for date_val in pivot.index:
        row_text = []
        for mile_col in pivot.columns:
            val = pivot.loc[date_val, mile_col]
            if pd.notna(val):
                row_text.append(f"{date_val.strftime('%b %d')}, Mile {int(mile_col)}: {format_pace(val)}/mi")
            else:
                row_text.append("")
        hover_text.append(row_text)

    pace_lo = splits_df["split_pace"].quantile(0.05)
    pace_hi = splits_df["split_pace"].quantile(0.95)
    tick_vals = list(range(int(pace_lo), int(pace_hi) + 2))

    fig.add_trace(go.Heatmap(
        z=pivot.values,
        x=mile_labels,
        y=date_labels,
        text=hover_text,
        hovertemplate="%{text}<extra></extra>",
        colorscale=[[0, "#00d4aa"], [0.5, "#ffc107"], [1, "#dc3545"]],
        zmin=pace_lo,
        zmax=pace_hi,
        colorbar=dict(
            title="min/mi", len=0.6, thickness=12,
            tickvals=tick_vals,
            ticktext=[f"{v}:00" for v in tick_vals],
        ),
        xgap=3, ygap=2,
    ))

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    height=max(450, len(pivot) * 20),
    xaxis=dict(side="top", showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=False),
    hovermode="closest",
    annotations=[dict(
        text="Green = faster. Red = slower. Even colors across a row = consistent pacing.",
        xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0.5, y=-0.05,
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
    )],
))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
fig = go.Figure()

if not z2_df.empty:
    estimates = z2_df[z2_df["source"] == "estimate"]
    streams_pts = z2_df[z2_df["source"] == "stream"]

    if not estimates.empty:
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=estimates["date"], y=estimates["z2_pace"],
            mode="markers",
            name="Estimated (avg HR in zone 2)",
            marker=dict(size=7, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.3)"),
            text=estimates["z2_pace"].apply(format_pace),
            hovertemplate="%{x|%b %d, %Y}<br>Pace: %{text}<extra></extra>",
        ))

    if not streams_pts.empty:
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=streams_pts["date"], y=streams_pts["z2_pace"],
            mode="markers",
            name="Stream-based (precise)",
            marker=dict(size=10, color="#00d4aa", symbol="diamond"),
            text=streams_pts["z2_pace"].apply(format_pace),
            hovertemplate="%{x|%b %d, %Y}<br>Pace: %{text}<extra></extra>",
        ))

    if not z2_monthly.empty:
        monthly_x = z2_monthly.index.to_timestamp() + pd.Timedelta(days=15)
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=monthly_x, y=z2_monthly.values,
            mode="lines+markers",
            name="Monthly average",
            line=dict(color="#00d4aa", width=3),
            marker=dict(size=12),
            text=[format_pace(p) for p in z2_monthly.values],
            hovertemplate="%{x|%b %Y}<br>Avg: %{text}<extra></extra>",
        ))

if not z2_df.empty:
    y_lo = int(z2_df["z2_pace"].min()) - 1
    y_hi = int(z2_df["z2_pace"].max()) + 2
else:
    y_lo, y_hi = 8, 18

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    height=500,
    yaxis=dict(
        title="Pace (min/mi)",
        autorange="reversed",
        tickvals=list(range(y_lo, y_hi + 1)),
        ticktext=[f"{m}:00" for m in range(y_lo, y_hi + 1)],
        gridcolor=GRID_COLOR,
    ),
    xaxis=dict(gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    hovermode="closest",
    annotations=[dict(
        text="↑ Faster is up. Dots = individual runs, line = monthly average.",
        xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0, y=-0.08,
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
    )],
))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

fig = go.Figure()

chart_annotations = [dict(
    text=(
        f"Median HR during seconds at {format_pace(REFERENCE_PACE)}/mi "
        f"(\u00b1{format_pace(REFERENCE_PACE_BAND)}). Declining = improving aerobic fitness."
    ),
    xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0.5, y=-0.1,
    showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
)]

if not ref_pace_df.empty:
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=ref_pace_df["date"], y=ref_pace_df["median_hr"],
        mode="markers", name="Median HR",
        marker=dict(size=10, color="#ff6b6b", opacity=0.8),
        customdata=ref_pace_df["n_seconds"],
        hovertemplate="%{x|%b %d, %Y}<br>Median HR: %{y:.0f} bpm<br>%{customdata} sec at pace<extra></extra>",
    ))

    if len(ref_pace_df) >= 3:
        x_num = ref_pace_df["date"].astype("int64") / 1e18
        z = np.polyfit(x_num, ref_pace_df["median_hr"], 1)
        trend_y = np.poly1d(z)(x_num.values)
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=ref_pace_df["date"], y=trend_y,
            mode="lines", name="Trend",
            line=dict(color="#4dabf7", width=2, dash="dash"),
        ))
        days_span = (ref_pace_df["date"].max() - ref_pace_df["date"].min()).days
        if days_span > 0:
            change = (trend_y[-1] - trend_y[0]) / (days_span / 30)
            arrow = "\u2193" if change < 0 else "\u2191"
            chart_annotations.append(dict(
                x=ref_pace_df["date"].iloc[len(ref_pace_df) // 2],
                y=ref_pace_df["median_hr"].max() + 3,
                text=f"{arrow} {abs(change):.1f} bpm/month",
                showarrow=False, font=dict(size=14, color="#4dabf7"),
            ))
else:
    chart_annotations.append(dict(
        x=0.5, y=0.5, xref="paper", yref="paper",
        text="No stream data with sufficient seconds at reference pace",
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=14, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"),
    ))

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    height=500,
    yaxis=dict(title="Heart Rate (bpm)", gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    xaxis=dict(gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    hovermode="closest",
    annotations=chart_annotations,
))
fig.show()
```

## Pace vs. Heart Rate by Month

```{python}
#| echo: false

fig = go.Figure()

chart_annotations = [dict(
    text="Each dot = 30-sec avg. If clouds shift DOWN over months at the same pace, fitness is improving.",
    xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0.5, y=-0.1,
    showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
)]

if not scatter_df.empty:
    months_ordered = sorted(scatter_df["date"].dt.to_period("M").unique())
    palette = ["#ff6b6b", "#ffc107", "#00d4aa", "#4dabf7", "#a855f7", "#f97316"]

    for i, m in enumerate(months_ordered):
        mask = scatter_df["date"].dt.to_period("M") == m
        chunk = scatter_df[mask]
        color = palette[i % len(palette)]
        label = m.strftime("%b '%y")

        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=chunk["pace"], y=chunk["hr"],
            mode="markers", name=label,
            marker=dict(size=4, color=color, opacity=0.3),
            hovertemplate=f"{label}<br>Pace: %{{x:.1f}} min/mi<br>HR: %{{y:.0f}} bpm<extra></extra>",
        ))

        if len(chunk) >= 10:
            z = np.polyfit(chunk["pace"], chunk["hr"], 1)
            pace_range = np.linspace(chunk["pace"].min(), chunk["pace"].max(), 50)
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
                x=pace_range, y=np.poly1d(z)(pace_range),
                mode="lines", name=f"{label} trend",
                line=dict(color=color, width=2),
                showlegend=False, hoverinfo="skip",
            ))

    fig.add_vline(
        x=REFERENCE_PACE, line_dash="dash",
        line_color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)",
    )
    chart_annotations.append(dict(
        x=REFERENCE_PACE, y=1.02, xref="x", yref="paper",
        text=f"Ref: {format_pace(REFERENCE_PACE)}/mi",
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=11, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"),
    ))

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    height=500,
    xaxis=dict(title="Pace (min/mi)", autorange="reversed", gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    yaxis=dict(title="Heart Rate (bpm)", gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    hovermode="closest",
    annotations=chart_annotations,
))
fig.show()
```

## Rolling Mileage

```{python}
#| echo: false

fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=daily["date"], y=daily["rolling_90d"],
    mode="lines", name=f"{ROLLING_LONG}-day",
    line=dict(color="#ff6b6b", width=2),
    hovertemplate="%{x|%b %d, %Y}<br>%{y:.1f} mi<extra></extra>",
))

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=daily["date"], y=daily["rolling_30d"],
    mode="lines", name=f"{ROLLING_SHORT}-day",
    line=dict(color="#4dabf7", width=2),
    hovertemplate="%{x|%b %d, %Y}<br>%{y:.1f} mi<extra></extra>",
))

building = daily["rolling_30d"] >= daily["rolling_90d"]
changes = building.ne(building.shift()).cumsum()
for seg_id in changes.unique():
    mask = changes == seg_id
    seg = daily[mask]
    if len(seg) < 2:
        continue
    fig.add_vrect(
        x0=seg["date"].iloc[0], x1=seg["date"].iloc[-1],
        fillcolor="rgba(0,212,170,0.07)" if building[mask].iloc[0] else "rgba(255,107,107,0.07)",
        line_width=0, layer="below",
    )

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    yaxis=dict(title="Miles", gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    xaxis=dict(gridcolor=GRID_COLOR),
    hovermode="x unified",
    annotations=[dict(
        text="Green = building (30d > 90d). Red = declining.",
        xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0.5, y=-0.1,
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
    )],
))
fig.show()
```

## Run Frequency

```{python}
#| echo: false

day_labels = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
cal_start = daily["date"].iloc[0]

daily_cal = daily.copy()
daily_cal["dow"] = daily_cal["date"].dt.dayofweek
daily_cal["week"] = ((daily_cal["date"] - cal_start).dt.days) // 7

n_weeks = int(daily_cal["week"].max()) + 1
grid = np.zeros((7, n_weeks))
text_grid = np.full((7, n_weeks), "", dtype=object)

for _, r in daily_cal.iterrows():
    w, d = int(r["week"]), int(r["dow"])
    grid[d, w] = r["miles"]
    text_grid[d, w] = r["date"].strftime("%b %d, %Y")

# Month tick positions
month_ticks, month_tick_labels = [], []
for m in pd.period_range(daily["date"].dt.to_period("M").iloc[0],
                         daily["date"].dt.to_period("M").iloc[-1], freq="M"):
    ts = m.to_timestamp()
    if ts >= cal_start:
        month_ticks.append((ts - cal_start).days // 7)
        month_tick_labels.append(ts.strftime("%b '%y"))

fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Heatmap(
    z=grid,
    x=list(range(n_weeks)),
    y=day_labels,
    text=text_grid,
    colorscale=[
        [0, "#161b22"],
        [0.05, "#0e4429"],
        [0.3, "#006d32"],
        [0.6, "#26a641"],
        [1.0, "#39d353"],
    ],
    zmin=0,
    zmax=max(daily["miles"].max(), 1),
    xgap=3, ygap=3,
    hovertemplate="%{text}<br>%{z:.1f} miles<extra></extra>",
    colorbar=dict(title="Miles", len=0.6, thickness=12),
))

# Soccer overlay (orange circles)
soccer_dates = set(soccer["date"].dt.date)
sx = [int(r["week"]) for _, r in daily_cal.iterrows() if r["date"].date() in soccer_dates]
sy = [day_labels[int(r["dow"])] for _, r in daily_cal.iterrows() if r["date"].date() in soccer_dates]

if sx:
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=sx, y=sy,
        mode="markers", name="Soccer",
        marker=dict(size=9, color="orange", symbol="circle-open",
                    line=dict(width=2, color="orange")),
        hovertemplate="Soccer<extra></extra>",
    ))

fig.update_layout(**chart_layout(
    height=280,
    xaxis=dict(tickvals=month_ticks, ticktext=month_tick_labels,
               tickangle=-45, showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed", showgrid=False),
    hovermode="closest",
    annotations=[dict(
        text="Green = running (brighter = more miles). Orange circles = soccer.",
        xref="paper", yref="paper", x=0.5, y=-0.18,
        showarrow=False, font=dict(size=12, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"),
    )],
))
fig.show()
```
